Neither the 3-of-6 manager Safe nor the Inverse Timelock operator can target or freeze invUSD holder balances. Verdict: No.

oracleRisk.summary: One composite feed prices sINV collateral: ERC4626Feed multiplies the sINV vault exchange rate by a governance-switchable SwitchFeed currently pointing to DynamicFeeCurveFeed, which combines a single Curve INV/WETH pool EMA (price_oracle()) with Chainlink ETH/USD (and a RedStone ETH/USD fallback), discounted by the Curve dynamic fee up to 2%. Although the ETH/USD leg has a fallback, INV/ETH relies solely on one Curve pool EMA and SwitchFeed lets the Inverse 2-day Timelock swap the underlying feed within a 10% divergence check. Stale answers older than 86,400 seconds force reduce-only and linearly unwind the price over 24 hours; reverting or non-positive answers disable liquidations and redemptions.

branchApplicability.rationale: invUSD operates a single sINV borrower market whose collateral is valued by a multi-hop composite oracle inside an automated liquidation and redemption engine, so collateral pricing, liquidation parameters, backstop and bad-debt behavior require branch-level evidence. The market carried all 276,807.17 invUSD of CDP debt and 106,203.87 sINV of collateral at block 26506036.

branches.label: sINV Lender market
branches.summary: The market's sole collateral asset is sINV, priced in USD by ERC4626Feed -> SwitchFeed -> DynamicFeeCurveFeed -> ChainlinkBasePriceFeed. INV/WETH pricing comes solely from a single Curve INV/WETH pool EMA with no alternate INV venue and is subject to Timelock feed switching via SwitchFeed; only the ETH/USD base leg carries a RedStone fallback.

feeds.path: sINV.previewRedeem(1e18) (fallback convertToAssets) * SwitchFeed.latestRoundData() / 1e18; returned 7.953034 USD at block 26506036
Pass-through feed operated by Inverse 2-day Timelock (0x926df14a23be491164dcf93f4c468a50ef659d5b) that can switch underlying feeds within 1,000 bps divergence; currently points to DynamicFeeCurveFeed

Curve INV/WETH pool (0xdcd90d866ff9636e5a04768825d05d27b3fb19ec) price_oracle() EMA (0.00446557 ETH/INV) * ETH/USD less dynamic Curve fee (1.086%, capped at gov-set maxFee 2%); single DEX venue for INV/ETH with no alternate INV feed

Chainlink ETH/USD (0x5f4ec3df9cbd43714fe2740f5e3616155c5b8419, heartbeat 3,660s, read 1,728.60 USD updated 2026-11-27T09:54:59Z) falling back to RedStone ETH/USD (0x67f6838e58859d612e4ddf04da396d6dabb66dc4, read 1,726.20 USD) on staleness or aggregator bounds breach

branches.fallbackBehavior: ChainlinkBasePriceFeed automatically falls back from Chainlink ETH/USD to RedStone ETH/USD when the Chainlink ETH/USD answer is stale beyond 3,660 seconds or out of aggregator bounds. However, the INV/WETH leg has no alternate DEX or CEX oracle fallback, and SwitchFeed requires an Inverse 2-day Timelock governance action to switch feeds. On the Lender, an updatedAt older than the immutable 86,400-second stalenessThreshold forces reduce-only and linearly unwinds the collateral price toward 1 wei over 24 hours; a reverting or non-positive answer disables liquidations, redemptions and write-offs until the feed recovers.

collateralParameters.note: Lender 0xf8b349da9244253288f6853835e6582955fd49c9 at block 26506036: immutable collateralFactor() 6,500 bps (65% max LTV, 153.85% MCR), minDebt() 500 invUSD, MIN_LIQUIDATION_DEBT 10,000 invUSD, liquidation incentive 0% at 65% LTV rising linearly to 10% at 70% LTV, and per-call repay cap min(debt, max(debt/4, 10,000)). Single borrower market accounts for 100% of CDP debt.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Anyone may call liquidate() once a borrower's debt exceeds 65% of sINV collateral value. Each call repays up to min(debt, max(debt/4, 10,000)) capped by remaining collateral value, burns the repaid invUSD and seizes sINV at the oracle price plus a 0 to 10% incentive scaling linearly between 65% and 70% LTV.
branches.backstop: No funded Stability Pool, insurance fund or bad-debt auction exists. Liquidators seize borrower sINV at a discount funded from that borrower's collateral; residual shortfalls beyond 100x collateral value are socialised pro rata across surviving borrowers via writeOff().
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: No pause, emergency shutdown or bad-debt auction exists. A reverting or non-positive feed disables liquidations, redemptions and write-offs; staleness past 86,400 seconds triggers reduce-only and a 24-hour linear price unwind. When writeOff() fires at >100x debt-to-collateral, bad debt is socialised across surviving borrowers (or deleted unbacked if the last borrower is written off).
